atoms.b: The ((++United_Kingdom United_Nations)) (UK) is a union of ((++four five)) countries. The capital city of the UK is ((++London Belfast)). England is the ((++biggest smallest)) country in the UK. It can be divided into three major regions: South, Midlands, and North.
Scotland is located ((++north east)) of England. When there are cultural events in Scotland, people wear special clothes like ((++kilts scarfs)). Some people also play the ((++bagpipes pipebags)).
Wales is located ((++west south)) of England. Some people living there not only speak English, but also ((++Welsh Greek)).
Northern Ireland is the ((++smallest biggest)) country in the UK. It's the northern part of the ((++island iceland)) of Ireland. The main part of Ireland ((++isn't is)) part of the UK.
